title: Trace beta reduction
description: This tracer represents lambda terms as tuples and reduces them one outermost redex at a time.

steps.description: The three tuple constructors represent variables, lambda abstractions, and applications.
pretty recursively formats each tuple shape as a readable lambda expression.
free_vars collects variable names that remain free. A lambda removes its own parameter from the body's free variables.
subst replaces free occurrences of a variable. Before entering a lambda, it checks whether the replacement would capture the lambda's bound variable.

steps.question: What happens when the replacement has the lambda parameter as a free variable?
steps.answer: The tracer creates a fresh parameter name, alpha-renames the body, and then continues substitution.

steps.description: step reduces an application whose function is a lambda. Otherwise it searches the function part, then the argument, for an outermost reducible expression.
normalize repeatedly calls step, prints each result, and stops when no reduction remains.
The demos trace identity, the K combinator, applying g twice, a capture case, and two free-variable sets.
